newsitem.title: JAPAN: Scrapping of securities tax one option -- LDP.
newsitem.headline: Scrapping of securities tax one option -- LDP.

text.p: Scrapping Japan's securities transaction tax is one of the options that should be considered in a review of the country's tax system, a senior official of the ruling Liberal Democratic Party told a news conference on Friday.
The party earlier announced a set of financial deregulation proposals that included a call for a review of the securities transaction tax.
"The abolition of the securities transaction tax system will be one option to be considered," the official said.

The LDP's deregulation proposals cover more than 100 areas in 10 categories, including the financial system, transportation, telecommunications, land, the medical system and monopoly regulation, the official said.
He said there were many other items that should be deregulated but it would take more time to finalise proposals on them.
He said the government should devise specific plans by the end of September for deregulation measures not included in the LDP proposals.
Various advisory panels to the government are expected to finalise their deregulation proposals around June.
